lead.title: Project Lead
lead.description: Select the project lead for the project.

assignee.title: Default Assignee
assignee.description: Select the default assignee for the project.

guest_access.title: Guest access
guest_access.description: This will allow guests to have view access to all the project work items.

add_members.title: Add members
add_members.sub_heading: Add workspace members to work on your project.

states.heading: States
states.description: Define and customize workflow states to track the progress of your work items.

empty_state.title: No states available for the {group} group

states.description_placeholder: Describe this state for your members.

delete.title: Delete state
delete.body: Are you sure you want to delete state {name}? All of the data related to the state will be permanently removed. This action cannot be undone.

labels.heading: Labels
labels.description: Create custom labels to categorize and organize your work items
labels.label_max_char: Label name should not exceed 255 characters
labels.parent_not_allowed: A label can go only under a label at the top of its project, and a label with labels under it stays at the top: labels have two levels.

delete.title: Delete label
delete.body: Are you sure you want to delete {name}? This will remove the label from every work item and from the views that filter by it.

automations.label: Automations
automations.heading: Automations
automations.description: Configure automated actions to streamline your project management workflow and reduce manual tasks.

auto-archive.title: Auto-archive closed work items
auto-archive.description: Nerve will auto archive work items that have been completed or canceled.
auto-archive.duration: Auto-archive work items that are closed for

cycles.title: Cycles
cycles.description: Schedule work in flexible periods that adapt to this project's unique rhythm and pace.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Organize work into sub-projects with dedicated leads and assignees.

views.title: Views
views.description: Save custom sorts, filters, and display options or share them with your team.

intake.description: Consider and discuss work items before you add them to your project.
